subject: Supersede dashboard localization task with complete sync binding
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: F89-DASHBOARD-REMAINING-L10N-R2
WIRE: CODEX-F89-DASHBOARD-REMAINING-L10N-R2-TASK-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: NONE
SUPERSEDES: CODEX-F89-DASHBOARD-REMAINING-L10N-R1-TASK-001
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Fetch and verify the exact source commit, create only the isolated source copy, implement the named localization slice, run the owning checks, and return one evidence-bearing PROGRESS followed by one strict flat DELIVERY or one terminal BLOCKED
REASON: REPLACE_TASK_WITH_COMPLETE_SYNC_BINDING
PAYLOAD_SHA256: NONE
PAYLOAD:
READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
SOURCE_REPO: github.com/dominator509/axiom
SOURCE_BRANCH: refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
SOURCE_REF: refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening

SOURCE_SYNC_COMMAND: git --git-dir=/srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/inbox/codex-f89-dashboard-remaining-l10n-r2/mirror fetch --all --prune
SOURCE_MIRROR_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/inbox/codex-f89-dashboard-remaining-l10n-r2/mirror
SOURCE_MIRROR_LAYOUT: bare-mirror — refs/heads/*
SOURCE_REF_VERIFY_COMMAND: git --git-dir=/srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/inbox/codex-f89-dashboard-remaining-l10n-r2/mirror rev-parse --verify refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
SOURCE_COMMIT_VERIFY_COMMAND: git --git-dir=/srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/inbox/codex-f89-dashboard-remaining-l10n-r2/mirror cat-file -t fb523d2497ca370b2272e274376d622395fe5e98^{commit}
SOURCE_ANCESTRY_VERIFY_COMMAND: git --git-dir=/srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/inbox/codex-f89-dashboard-remaining-l10n-r2/mirror merge-base --is-ancestor fb523d2497ca370b2272e274376d622395fe5e98 refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
WORKTREE_KIND: source-copy — exact commit; never a moving branch checkout
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/inbox/codex-f89-dashboard-remaining-l10n-r2/copy
DELIVERY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/inbox/codex-f89-dashboard-remaining-l10n-r2/delivery
PREVIOUS_LANE_DISPOSITION: The R1 task was accepted but never produced a source copy, progress artifact, or delivery; its missing SOURCE_REF_HEAD made it ineligible for the sync gate. Treat R1 and the old character lane as historical and inert.
MISSION: Close the remaining mounted dashboard localization gap in the existing six-locale catalog without changing API contracts, authentication, provider behavior, storage semantics, or authored/provider data.
SCOPE: packages/dashboard/components/GrokConnection.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/GrokConnection.test.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/GrokR2Storage.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/GrokR2Storage.test.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/PerformancePatterns.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/PerformancePatterns.test.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/NewModelForm.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/NewModelForm.test.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/ModelTabs.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/SignOutButton.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/SignOutButton.test.tsx; the smallest directly-owned shared catalog/completeness test additions required by these surfaces.
REQUIREMENTS: Replace user-visible hardcoded English headings, descriptions, status/error/success copy, labels, placeholders, button text and accessible labels with typed shared-catalog keys for en, es, ja, it, pt-BR and de. Preserve Grok/R2 request methods, credential boundaries, provider identifiers, endpoints, model identifiers, authored performance labels/data, sign-out behavior, role-specific navigation and existing error redaction. Use selected-locale number/date formatting only where a displayed value is a date or number; do not translate authored/provider values.
PASS_1: Every named mounted component must consume the existing locale provider/catalog at its real render callsite; helper-only, copied-baseline, docs-only or generated-output changes fail.
PASS_2: Focused behavior tests must cover locale switching for every changed surface, loading/empty/success/error states, accessible labels and preservation of non-translatable provider/authored values.
PASS_3: Catalog completeness must prove every new key exists in all six launch locales and missing-key fallback remains fail-closed. Do not introduce a second locale source.
PASS_4: Preserve existing API payloads, auth/session boundaries, idempotency, secret non-readback, provider-connection semantics, model-role filtering and sign-out semantics. No provider calls, OAuth, credentials, runtime services, database or migration actions.
PASS_5: Run the focused dashboard tests, core catalog/completeness tests, dashboard typecheck and lint; report exact commands and real exit codes.
PASS_6: DELIVERY must be a flat protocol-valid block containing ARTIFACT, SHA256, COMMAND, EXIT_CODE, TEST_RESULT, CHANGED_FILES, SOURCE_REPO, SOURCE_REF, SOURCE_COMMIT, COPY_ROOT, DELIVERY_ROOT, MANIFEST_SHA256 and LIVE_ACTIONS exactly once, with one final canonical signature.
BLOCK_RULE: If a named component requires a missing architectural catalog contract or an API change outside this source-only scope, return one terminal BLOCKED naming the exact file and missing prerequisite; do not claim partial delivery.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, deployment, live or disposable database, migrations, providers, OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, generated output, old inbox/reply/status/outbox/worktree identities, and paths outside COPY_ROOT/DELIVERY_ROOT. Do not use dates, clocks or filesystem timestamps for coordination.
sincerely, Codex
